title: Predictive Abstraction Lab
thesis: An abstraction is justified only to the extent that it compresses observations and continues to predict after the mechanism, source, time, and domain change.

prerequisites.label: Distinguishability
prerequisites.question: Is the proposed pattern measurably different from alternatives?
prerequisites.gate: A candidate needs a reproducible contrast, geometry, or outcome difference.

prerequisites.label: Similarity
prerequisites.question: Do related observations remain close under a declared metric?
prerequisites.gate: Similarity must survive resampling or an alternative representation.

prerequisites.label: Persistence
prerequisites.question: Does the structure recur when samples, thresholds, or time change?
prerequisites.gate: A one-split effect is a mechanism candidate, not an invariant.

prerequisites.label: Predictability
prerequisites.question: Does the compressed representation improve prediction on data that could not select it?
prerequisites.gate: The candidate must beat an appropriate baseline out of fold or out of distribution.

ranking.method: Pareto fronts within comparable target families
ranking.reason: Description length, stability, source diversity, and predictive error are not commensurable enough for an honest universal weighted sum.
ranking.weakestLinkRule: A failed prerequisite caps promotion regardless of sample size or strength on the other dimensions.

hierarchy.label: Mechanism
hierarchy.definition: A stable pattern or model inside one observed setting.

hierarchy.label: Local invariant
hierarchy.definition: Survives grouped resampling and perturbations inside one bounded corpus.

hierarchy.label: Regional invariant
hierarchy.definition: Predicts in independently held-out sources inside one content domain.

hierarchy.label: Domain invariant
hierarchy.definition: Survives multiple independently sampled corpora, sources, and formats.

hierarchy.label: Universal invariant
hierarchy.definition: Keeps predicting across every tested domain and transformation. Current data cannot justify this tier.

operationalContract.diversityRule: Independent mechanism and source families matter more than repeated rows from the same family.
operationalContract.mdlBoundary: A valid minimum-description-length score must encode the model, abstraction, and residuals. Display-label length is shown only as an audit field and never promotes a candidate.

sources.label: Operations saved-hook discovery bank
sources.validation: Outcome-blind multi-algorithm discovery plus grouped internal inference
sources.claimBoundary: Saved-hook records do not contain creator IDs. Discovery inference and fold stability are grouped by exact and near-duplicate semantic lineage, not held-out creator, and therefore apply only to this saved bank.

sources.label: Exact-ID-disjoint private keep diagnostic
sources.claimBoundary: The observed diagnostic contains 632 private videos that are exact-ID disjoint from the saved-hook discovery bank; only 16 are at least 85%, across 4 groups. It is separately labeled, low power, and not corrected replication.

sources.label: Private pooled retention outcomes
sources.validation: Known-account folds, forward-time backtest, unseen-account stress test
sources.claimBoundary: The known-account interpolation score is not a pre-upload forecast. The forward-time test uses current frozen public reference axes and historical private labels, while the unseen-account test remains negative; do not claim a universal keep-rate model.

sources.label: Saved-channel public views
sources.validation: Known-channel folds, forward-time backtest, unseen-channel stress test
sources.claimBoundary: The operational score calibrates to a known channel's historical scale. Publication dates are present for 1,418 of 1,418 eligible Shorts, but outcomes are still current-view snapshots rather than fixed 30-day views. The forward-time ordering is retrospective and cannot reconstruct as-of view labels; unseen-channel transfer is also reported separately.

sources.label: Science Center raw embedding corpus
sources.validation: Raw 1,536D geometry refit inside creator-group folds
sources.claimBoundary: Raw 1,536D Gemini geometry refit inside five creator-group folds; no saved steered views score is reused. Labels are current public-view snapshots, so age-cohort and creator-macro diagnostics are reported separately

sources.label: Long Quant to Shorts frozen transfer
sources.validation: Long-form-only fit transferred without Shorts labels
sources.claimBoundary: A frozen long-form title/thumbnail views axis is trained only on Long Quant, then transferred directly into the matching Shorts modality without seeing a Short outcome.

sources.label: Sealed pooled opening-retention evaluation
sources.validation: Prediction-only manifest sealed before outcomes and near-duplicate isolation
sources.claimBoundary: The 208 saved cohort rows are source-level out of fold. Other Main rows use the unchanged full fit. Other accounts are account-external frozen-model evaluations. Primary blind metrics exclude exact and conservative near training-content overlap. Exact or near external repost members remain inspectable but share one sealed content-component statistical vote. Near-duplicate sensitivity is outcome-free and reported at multiple thresholds. Outcomes are opened only after the prediction manifest is sealed; no pooled outcome refits, recalibrates, or promotes the scorer.

sources.label: Four-cluster opening context study
sources.validation: Observed ordering association plus synthetic sensitivity controls
sources.claimBoundary: Observed source-grouped prediction can support an ordering association. Synthetic swaps and shuffled-history controls are model sensitivity tests, not randomized causal evidence.

sources.label: Private Shorts retention study
sources.outcome: Observed keep, retention, duration, and views
sources.grouping: Video folds inside one creator cohort
sources.claimBoundary: Post-upload observational inputs; one creator cohort.

quarantinedSources.label: Legacy mechanism-to-indicator bridge
quarantinedSources.reason: Retrospective chain-strength ranking without the current discovery, correction, and transport contract.

quarantinedSources.label: Legacy retention pattern waves
quarantinedSources.reason: Exploratory findings and design-language interpretations are not an independent validation artifact.

quarantinedSources.label: Legacy v27 prediction model
quarantinedSources.reason: Contains a documented history of circular-feature removal; retained for audit, not principle promotion.

quarantinedSources.label: Promise Lab forward-response diagnostic
quarantinedSources.reason: Artifact explicitly marks itself deconfounded but unvalidated and conditional on a post-hoc category map.

quarantinedSources.label: Promise Lab hook-quality diagnostic
quarantinedSources.reason: Useful component diagnostics, but not promoted over the sealed strict-blind candidate-versus-baseline result.
